mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS tightening is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances following a 3-month GDP increase, or if GDP growth does not correlate with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE spikes and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO declines and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals a weakening in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between HOUST declines and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the interaction effect of high FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE on returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between PAYEMS growth and positive returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in one month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and positive returns is not significant (p > 0.05).
